ATX 3.1 Support & a Durable 12V-2x6 Adapter Cable
Includes ATX 3.1 support and a 90-degree 12V-2x6 PCIe 5.1 connector with higher electrical durability and three 8-pin connectors with improved safety, capable of bringing up to 600W to your GPU.*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
High Temperature Resilience​
A 50°C operating temperature and high quality Japanese capacitors allow for pushing your machine to the limits.​
Certified Efficiency
The MWE Gold V2 ATX 3.1 is certified to achieve more than 90% efficiency at typical loads.​​
Three 8-pin Connectors
Up to 600W of power is split between three 8-pin connectors, providing enhanced safety.
Fully Modular Cabling
Modular cabling reduces clutter, increases airflow, and improves overall thermal performance.
PSU Calculator
Need help choosing the right power supply for your system? Try out our comprehensive and easy-to-use PSU calculator.
